purpose: Determine whether the existing training trajectories contain enough cross-recording state matches with divergent actions and separable true future latents to support one pseudo-branching world-model pilot.

representation.current_state: 4x4x32 pooled current DINO latent, globally centered and L2 normalized
representation.history_motion: current minus first history-frame pooled DINO latent, globally centered and L2 normalized
representation.signature: L2-normalized concatenation of current state and 0.25 times history motion
representation.future: H4 pooled true latent minus current pooled latent

if_go: freeze matched-pair construction and train one true-future-latent pseudo-branching pilot with route-disjoint validation
if_no_go: do not retrain on pseudo branches; require resettable or simulator branching future-latent data
